_comment: A generic example. It describes nobody. Copy it to ~/.claude/communication-rules.json, replace every value with traits your own reader actually has, and keep that copy out of version control if it describes a real person. The hook reads reader and traits and nothing else: the shipped check's markers, minProseChars and graceChars are set by whatever code calls the check, as a function argument, so they are not profile fields.
reader: the engineer who owns this service
traits: reads the first two lines of any message and skims the rest
wants the decision named before the reasoning that produced it
treats an unanswered question as answered unless it is the last line
